clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker gathers reports from the coast. The Ironforge dwarf works outside the Temple of the Moon, where he coordinates the Explorers' League's research and tracks colleagues in Darkshore.

Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker works outside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, far from his home in Ironforge. He represents the Explorers' League, which sent him across the sea to Kalimdor for fieldwork. There, he speaks with night elf scholars such as Tarelvir and seeks knowledge of the ancient lands. In Ironforge, his lectures covered ancient lore and primordial beings, including the Wild God Agamaggan. Now he hopes to learn what the night elves' ancestral lands hold.

In Kalimdor, Greywhisker oversees dwarven excavations and follows expeditions searching ancient coastal ruins. He depends on travelers to carry messages to prospectors across the sea in Darkshore. Field research in unexplored lands is perilous, and he waits anxiously for reports from the dig sites, hoping his colleagues are safe among the ruins.
